name: Quote breakdown
description: The store's quote: subtotal, its own charges, delivery, tip and total.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/quote-breakdown", name: "Quote breakdown", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "The store's quote: subtotal, its own charges, delivery, tip and total.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Box(padding: Space.lg, radius: Radius.lg, background: Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), child: Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [
      Row(children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: "Subtotal", color: Color.textMuted)), Text(child: formatMoney(checkout.quote.items_subtotal_cents))]),
      ForEach(items: checkout.quote.charges, as: "c", child: Row(children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: c.name, color: Color.textMuted)), Text(child: formatMoney(c.amount_cents))])),
      If(condition: checkout.quote.delivery_fee_cents > 0, then: Row(children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: "Delivery", color: Color.textMuted)), Text(child: formatMoney(checkout.quote.delivery_fee_cents))])),
      If(condition: checkout.quote.tip_cents > 0, then: Row(children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: "Tip", color: Color.textMuted)), Text(child: formatMoney(checkout.quote.tip_cents))])),
      Divider(),
      Row(children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: "Total", weight: FontWeight.bold)), Text(child: formatMoney(checkout.quote.total_cents), size: FontSize.lg, weight: FontWeight.bold)])
    ]))
  )], data: [Data(name: "checkout", from: Client.checkout(), fetch: "client", type: ClientCheckout)],
)
